# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_data_dictionary.py from the database COMMENTs. Do not edit by hand. -->

77 objects across three schemas. Every object states its **grain** (what one row is). Column notes appear where a column's meaning isn't obvious from its name.

## `core`

System of record. Normalised master data and transactions; stock is an append-only ledger (`stock_movement`), never overwritten.

| Object | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`bin`](#corebin) | table | Storage slots in DCs. assigned_product_id NULL = spare slot. |
| [`goods_receipt`](#coregoodsreceipt) | table | Grain: goods receipt note (GRN). A delivery received against a PO at a DC. |
| [`goods_receipt_line`](#coregoodsreceiptline) | table | Grain: GRN line. Quantity received and rejected per PO line; rejections feed supplier quality scores. |
| [`holiday`](#coreholiday) | table | Canadian statutory holidays (simplified national list, province CA). |
| [`location`](#corelocation) | table | Distribution centres and retail stores. |
| [`product`](#coreproduct) | table | SKU master with hierarchy (department > class > subclass > style). |
| [`product_price_history`](#coreproductpricehistory) | table | Grain: product x change date. Append-only cost and price versions (initial, supplier cost increase, retail price change). core.product holds the current version. |
| [`promotion`](#corepromotion) | table | Grain: promotion x product. Planned price promotions (start/end dates, discount %); drive demand uplift in the simulator. |
| [`purchase_order`](#corepurchaseorder) | table | Grain: purchase order. Header with lifecycle dates (created, submitted, approved, expected, closed), status and payment terms. |
| [`purchase_order_line`](#corepurchaseorderline) | table | Grain: PO line. Product, quantity ordered and agreed unit cost. |
| [`sales_daily`](#coresalesdaily) | table | Daily store sales, one row per store x product x day (zeros included). |
| [`stock_movement`](#corestockmovement) | table | Append-only inventory ledger. Stock on hand is always SUM(qty); there is no stored balance. |
| [`supplier`](#coresupplier) | table | Vendors. Performance is measured from transactions, not stored here. |
| [`supplier_invoice`](#coresupplierinvoice) | table | Grain: supplier invoice. Amount, due date from payment terms, status and paid date; source of payables. |
| [`transfer_order`](#coretransferorder) | table | Grain: transfer order. Stock moved between sites (DC to store, or rebalancing), with ship, expected and receive dates. |
| [`transfer_order_line`](#coretransferorderline) | table | Grain: transfer line. Product and quantity. |

## `analytics`

Star schema, model outputs and the views the API may read. The public API's role (`app_reader`) can read this schema only.

| Object | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`fact_inventory_daily`](#analyticsfactinventorydaily) | materialised view | Grain: day x location x product, end-of-day units. Refreshed nightly. |
| [`fact_po_line`](#analyticsfactpoline) | materialised view | Grain: PO line. on_time and filled_first_time drive the scorecard. |
| [`dim_date`](#analyticsdimdate) | table | Calendar dimension (calendar fiscal year). Extended forward nightly. |
| [`forecast_accuracy`](#analyticsforecastaccuracy) | table | Grain: run x product x location x model. Back-test WAPE and bias per candidate model; chosen = the model used for that series. |
| [`forecast_weekly`](#analyticsforecastweekly) | table | Grain: run x product x location x week x model. Weekly demand forecast with an 80% prediction interval. |
| [`inventory_kpi_monthly`](#analyticsinventorykpimonthly) | table | Grain: run x month x location. Annualised turns and GMROI, days of supply and stock-out rate per site. |
| [`model_run`](#analyticsmodelrun) | table | Grain: model run. Which model ran, as of which date, with which parameters; outputs below are keyed by run_id. |
| [`product_classification`](#analyticsproductclassification) | table | Grain: run x product. ABC (share of trailing 12-month revenue) and XYZ (coefficient of variation of weekly demand) classes. |
| [`replenishment_recommendation`](#analyticsreplenishmentrecommendation) | table | Grain: run x product x location. Statistical policy (service level by ABC class, safety stock, reorder point, EOQ) and the order it implies today. |
| [`dim_location`](#analyticsdimlocation) | view | Grain: site. Location dimension (DCs and stores) with region and serving DC. |
| [`dim_product`](#analyticsdimproduct) | view | Grain: product. Product dimension with hierarchy, cost, price, current reorder policy and supplier. |
| [`dim_product_scd2`](#analyticsdimproductscd2) | view | Grain: product version (SCD Type 2). Cost and price with validity range [valid_from, valid_to]; valid_to is null for the current version. |
| [`dim_supplier`](#analyticsdimsupplier) | view | Grain: supplier. Supplier dimension with terms, quoted lead time, ordering cost and price index. |
| [`fact_sales_daily`](#analyticsfactsalesdaily) | view | Grain: day x store x product. COGS and gross margin at the cost effective on the sale date (SCD Type 2). |
| [`v_abc_xyz`](#analyticsvabcxyz) | view | Grain: product. Latest ABC-XYZ classification and combined segment (e.g. AX). |
| [`v_as_of`](#analyticsvasof) | view | Single row: the date the data is simulated through (the as-of date of every response). |
| [`v_bin_stock`](#analyticsvbinstock) | view | Grain: DC bin. Assigned product, capacity, units held and last movement. |
| [`v_data_quality`](#analyticsvdataquality) | view | Grain: data-quality check. Results of the most recent successful load (pass/fail, observed count, severity). |
| [`v_ds_bins`](#analyticsvdsbins) | view | Dataset view, grain: DC bin with stock. Product, quantity, capacity and last movement. |
| [`v_ds_empty_bins`](#analyticsvdsemptybins) | view | Dataset view, grain: empty DC bin. |
| [`v_ds_invoices`](#analyticsvdsinvoices) | view | Dataset view, grain: supplier invoice. |
| [`v_ds_products`](#analyticsvdsproducts) | view | Dataset view, grain: product. Hierarchy, cost, price and network reorder policy. |
| [`v_ds_purchase_orders`](#analyticsvdspurchaseorders) | view | Dataset view, grain: PO. Open POs plus POs closed in the last 45 days. |
| [`v_ds_shelf`](#analyticsvdsshelf) | view | Dataset view, grain: product x store. Units on the shelf. |
| [`v_ds_stock`](#analyticsvdsstock) | view | Dataset view, grain: product. Network units on shelf (stores) and off shelf (DCs). |
| [`v_ds_suppliers`](#analyticsvdssuppliers) | view | Dataset view, grain: supplier. Master data plus measured performance and YTD spend. |
| [`v_ds_transfers`](#analyticsvdstransfers) | view | Dataset view, grain: transfer order. |
| [`v_ds_warehouses`](#analyticsvdswarehouses) | view | Dataset view, grain: site. Front-end shape of dim_location. |
| [`v_forecast`](#analyticsvforecast) | view | Grain: product x location x week. Latest forecast from the chosen model, with its back-test WAPE. |
| [`v_forecast_accuracy_series`](#analyticsvforecastaccuracyseries) | view | Grain: store series x candidate model. Back-test WAPE and bias from the latest forecast run (4 rolling origins x 8 weeks), chosen flag, and the series' 52-week demand used to weight accuracy. |
| [`v_forecast_network_weekly`](#analyticsvforecastnetworkweekly) | view | Grain: SKU x week. 26 weeks of actual network demand (units sold + lost) then the latest 8-week forecast summed across stores, with an 80% interval combined as root-sum-of-squares (assumes independent store errors). |
| [`v_goods_receipts`](#analyticsvgoodsreceipts) | view | Grain: GRN. Receipt header with PO, supplier, site, units received and rejected. |
| [`v_inventory_kpis`](#analyticsvinventorykpis) | view | Grain: month x location. Latest per-site KPIs with location codes. Use v_kpi_network_monthly for whole-business figures. |
| [`v_inventory_overview`](#analyticsvinventoryoverview) | view | Grain: location type. SKUs in stock, units and value at cost and retail. |
| [`v_inventory_positions`](#analyticsvinventorypositions) | view | Grain: location x product. On hand, on order, in transit, and value at cost and retail. |
| [`v_invoices`](#analyticsvinvoices) | view | Grain: supplier invoice. Status label (open, paid, overdue) derived from due date and the as-of date. |
| [`v_kpi_network_monthly`](#analyticsvkpinetworkmonthly) | view | Grain: month. Network GMROI, turns and days of supply (margin and COGS over store + DC inventory), store stock-out rate. Trailing 12 months of the latest KPI run. |
| [`v_latest_run`](#analyticsvlatestrun) | view | Grain: model. The most recent successful run of each model; model-output views join through it. |
| [`v_meta`](#analyticsvmeta) | view | Single row: data as-of date and the latest pipeline run time and status. |
| [`v_movements`](#analyticsvmovements) | view | Grain: stock movement. Ledger entries with readable type, location codes and reference document. |
| [`v_payables_by_terms`](#analyticsvpayablesbyterms) | view | Grain: payment terms. Open invoice amount, count and overdue amount. |
| [`v_po_cycle_time`](#analyticsvpocycletime) | view | Single row: average days from PO creation to closure, over POs closed in the last 12 months. |
| [`v_po_pipeline`](#analyticsvpopipeline) | view | Grain: lifecycle stage. Count and value of POs per stage (draft to closed). |
| [`v_po_status_label`](#analyticsvpostatuslabel) | view | Grain: PO status code. Display label used by the dashboard. |
| [`v_purchase_orders`](#analyticsvpurchaseorders) | view | Grain: purchase order. Header, supplier, status label, lines as JSON and totals. |
| [`v_reorder_alerts`](#analyticsvreorderalerts) | view | Grain: product. Network on hand vs reorder point, alert level and suggested order quantity and value. |
| [`v_replenishment`](#analyticsvreplenishment) | view | Grain: product x location. Latest replenishment recommendation with codes instead of ids. |
| [`v_spend_pareto`](#analyticsvspendpareto) | view | Grain: supplier. Spend rank, share and cumulative share (Pareto). |
| [`v_stock_on_hand`](#analyticsvstockonhand) | view | Grain: location x product. Units on hand, summed from the append-only stock ledger, and last movement date. |
| [`v_stock_trend_monthly`](#analyticsvstocktrendmonthly) | view | Grain: month. Month-end units on shelf (stores) and off shelf (DCs). |
| [`v_supplier_performance`](#analyticsvsupplierperformance) | view | Trailing 12 months, measured from receipts. |
| [`v_supplier_scorecard`](#analyticsvsupplierscorecard) | view | Grain: supplier. Measured on-time, quality, fill and lead time; six 0-100 component scores, weighted score and cohort (Strategic >= 82, Preferred >= 70, Approved >= 58, else Watchlist). |
| [`v_supplier_spend`](#analyticsvsupplierspend) | view | Grain: supplier. Year-to-date spend: ordered value of POs approved since 1 January of the as-of year, excluding cancelled. |
| [`v_transfers`](#analyticsvtransfers) | view | Grain: transfer order. Route, dates, status label and lines as JSON. |
| [`v_warehouse_floor`](#analyticsvwarehousefloor) | view | Grain: DC bin. Fill % and fill tier, for the warehouse floor map. |

### `analytics.forecast_accuracy`

*table.* Grain: run x product x location x model. Back-test WAPE and bias per candidate model; chosen = the model used for that series.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | bigint |  |
| `product_id` | integer |  |
| `location_id` | smallint |  |
| `model` | text |  |
| `wape` | numeric(10,4) |  |
| `bias` | numeric(10,4) |  |
| `chosen` | boolean |  |
| `backtest_actual` | numeric | Sum of actual demand over the back-test windows: the WAPE denominator, used to pool accuracy exactly across series. |
| `promo_actual` | numeric | Actual demand in back-test weeks that had a promotion (the promotion-week WAPE denominator). |
| `promo_abs_err` | numeric | Absolute forecast error in those weeks, with the promotion lift applied. |
| `promo_abs_err_no_lift` | numeric | Absolute forecast error in those weeks if promotions were ignored (the previous method). |
| `promo_lift` | numeric | Estimated lift beta for the series: demand = base x (1 + beta x weekly average discount). |

## `ops`

Pipeline state, job history and data-quality results.

| Object | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`audit_log`](#opsauditlog) | table | Every write made through the dev-only admin API. |
| [`dq_result`](#opsdqresult) | table | Grain: data-quality check x job run. Pass/fail and observed count; an error-severity failure rolls the whole run back. |
| [`job_run`](#opsjobrun) | table | Grain: pipeline job run (seed, nightly, analyze). Status, timings, row counts and error; the audit trail of every data change. |
| [`sim_config`](#opssimconfig) | table | Single row: parameters needed to rebuild the catalogue and continue the simulation. |
| [`sim_counter`](#opssimcounter) | table | Next document numbers / ids for the simulator (PO, GRN, TO, invoice...). |
| [`sim_plan`](#opssimplan) | table | Future events open entities are waiting on (simulation only; not business facts). |

### `ops.audit_log`

*table.* Every write made through the dev-only admin API.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `audit_id` | bigint |  |
| `at` | timestamp with time zone |  |
| `actor` | text |  |
| `action` | text |  |
| `entity` | text |  |
| `entity_ref` | text |  |
| `payload` | jsonb |  |

*table.* Grain: data-quality check x job run. Pass/fail and observed count; an error-severity failure rolls the whole run back.

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `dq_result_id` | bigint |  |
| `job_run_id` | bigint |  |
| `check_name` | text |  |

| `status` | text |  |
| `details` | jsonb |  |
| `error` | text |  |
